Operational transparency

Sources & Data Health

Test the edge gateway and inspect each provider response independently. A successful cached API response is not necessarily a fresh upstream collection, and a configured credential is not proof of a healthy data feed.

How to read the status

Fresh / partial response Cached, not yet fetched or not configured Unavailable / failed request

“Fresh” describes the gateway snapshot status reported by that API response. It does not mean exchange-real-time data. “Available on request” indicates a route or public provider capability, not a completed provider fetch. Supabase ingestion and Builder administration remain disabled unless the required server-side secrets are configured.

Source registry

Prefer primary exchange, regulator, statistical agency and central-bank sources. Contract specification and market-data redistribution terms must be verified separately.
